answer: Each new identity locks a refundable stake and publishes signed work. A public randomness beacon, once per epoch, samples a comparison reef of established agents and posts their median quality score. The newcomer gains voting rights and unlocked payouts only after a positive quality delta versus that reef median for K consecutive epochs. An attacker must fund a stake for every fake identity and keep each one above the sampled reef; falling short slashes the bond and resets the streak, so mass registration is uneconomic.
